x-e-e4-01.title: Nota inan nian no oras atu halimar ho Jisu.
x-e-e4-01.goal: Kompara planu sira iha nota inan nian ho oras ne'ebé belun ida sujere, buka ne'ebé la loos, no recuza iha Inglés hodi sujere oras seluk.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Nota ne'ebé inan husik iha meza (hakerek de'it, la iha imajen):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Depois nia belun Jisu haruka mensajen testu ida: “Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!”
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Kompara oras sira iha nota ho intervalu oras ne'ebé sujere, ida-idak.
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Avalia se intervalu oras ida no oras ida ne'ebé pontuál sobrepoin malu.
x-e-e4-01.thinking.2: Dehan iha Inglés no fó evidénsia.
x-e-e4-01.prereq.0: Signifikadu p.m. no oinsá lee oras (hanesan 3:30 no 4:00).
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Liafuan fasil hanesan piano class no trash.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Hili liña hotu iha nota ne'ebé tempu kona malu ho sujestaun Jisu nian (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tau liña ida-idak iha sorin oras parke “4:15-5:15”, no haree se nia remata molok ka hahú depois.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ba buat sira ne'ebé lori tempu, hanesan aula, kalkula oras ne'ebé remata.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Kompara se oras ita to'o uma mak molok ka depois 4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Kalkula oras hahú aula nian no oras remata, depois tau iha sorin oras parke.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Ha'u hanoin kona-ba ida-ne'e hanesan verifika se oras pontuál ida tama iha intervalu oras parke.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Kompara se oras jantar nian mak depois oras parke remata.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Aula pianu mak 4:00-4:30, nune'e 4:15-4:30 kona malu; hasai lixu iha 5:00 mós tama iha 4:15-5:15. To'o uma iha 3:30 no jantar iha 6:30 la tama iha oras parke.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Hatán Jisu ho fraze Inglés rua ka tolu. Buka razaun sira iha nota ne'ebé halo ita labele ba, hakerek sira, no sujere oras seluk ida ne'ebé bele.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Primeiru, recuza iha fraze ida ho “Sorry, I can't ...”.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hakerek planu rua ne'ebé kona malu iha nota ho sira-nia oras, no iha ikus sujere oras ho “Can we play at ...?”.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ita fó razaun rua hotu, kona-ba pianu no hasai lixu, ka lae?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ita sujere oras diferente ida, no oras ne'e la kona malu ho planu sira iha nota ka lae?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Iha fraze recuza ida hanesan “I can't” ka lae?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Resposta di'ak ida ne'ebé sujere oras hanesan intervalu.

x-e-e4-02.title: Deside oras atu la'o ho asu no oras atu halo servisu uma.
x-e-e4-02.goal: Halo kombinasaun diferente balu ba oras la'o no oras servisu uma ne'ebé kumpre kondisaun hotu iha nota Papa nian.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Nota ne'ebé Papa husik (hakerek de'it, la iha imajen):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Iha kraik, hakerek oras ida-idak hanesan “minutu hira hafoin 4:00 p.m.” Ezemplu, se ita hahú iha 4:30, hakerek 30, no se ita hahú iha 5:15, hakerek 75.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Halo rasik resposta ida ne'ebé kumpre kondisaun oioin iha tempu hanesan.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Aumenta durasaun ba oras hahú atu verifika oras remata.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.2: Verifika se atividade rua ne'e kona malu.
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Liafuan fasil hanesan walk the dog no homework.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Se Mina hahú homework iha 5:00 no la'o ho asu iha 5:30, kondisaun ida-ne'ebé iha nota mak nia la kumpre?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Aumenta durasaun (iha minutu) ba oras hahú tarefa ida-idak atu hetan oras nia remata.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dezeña intervalu oras tarefa rua nian iha liña ida, iha sorin malu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Kompara se oras hahú la'o 5:30 mak molok ka depois 5:00.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Tau homework 5:00-6:00 no la'o ho asu 5:30-6:00 iha sorin malu iha liña tempu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Buka oras remata tarefa rua nian hodi aumenta durasaun ba oras hahú ida-idak.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Ida-ne'e kondisaun kona-ba durasaun tarefa, la'ós kona-ba oras hahú.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Homework mak 5:00-6:00 no la'o ho asu mak 5:30-6:00, nune'e tarefa rua kona malu husi 5:30 to'o 6:00. La'o ho asu hahú hafoin 5:00 no tarefa rua hotu remata molok 6:30, nune'e kondisaun seluk sira kumpre.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Halo planu diferente 3 ne'ebé kumpre kondisaun hotu iha nota. w mak oras hahú la'o ho asu no k mak oras hahú homework (minutu hira hafoin 4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Primeiru deside intervalu w ba oras hahú la'o ho asu, depois hili oras hahú homework k ne'ebé la kona malu ho oras la'o ne'e.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Buka oras remata husi oras hahú tarefa ida-idak aumenta ho durasaun, no verifika se tarefa rua kona malu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.var.w: Oras hahú la'o ho asu (w minutu hafoin 4:00).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Hakerek w no k hanesan númeru-inteiru (minutu) ne'ebé 0 ka liu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: La'o ho asu ka homework remata hafoin 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Tarefa rua ne'e la kona malu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Oras la'o ho asu no homework kona malu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: La'o ho asu tenke hahú iha intervalu minutu 60 to'o 120 (5:00-6:00), no homework tenke hahú iha minutu 90 nia laran (to'o 5:30). Husi sira ne'e, kombinasaun ne'ebé la kona malu mak resposta. Ezemplu: (walk 60, homework 0), (walk 90, homework 0), (walk 60, homework 90).

x-e-e4-03.title: Mensajen testu Ken nian: lee liña ida-idak no koko hatene nia sentimentu.
x-e-e4-03.goal: Kada vez ita lee liña ida husi mensajen testu, koko fila fali hatene saida mak ita-nia belun hakarak, no muda ita-nia suposisaun uluk ho pista foun.
x-e-e4-03.material: Ita-nia belun Ken haruka mensajen testu ida. Sei hatudu parte ida-idak. Ba parte ida-idak, koko hatene saida mak Ken hakarak husi ita.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.0: Muda ita-nia suposisaun bainhira pista sira aumenta.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.1: Hatene katak fraze ida mesak la sufisiente atu hatene.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.2: Hakerek resposta iha Inglés no uza razaun (pista sira) hanesan evidénsia.
x-e-e4-03.prereq.0: Liafuan fasil hanesan cold no camp.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.prompt: Lee mensajen Ken nian parte ida-idak, no kada dala, koko adivinha saida mak Ken hakarak.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Buka liafuan ka númeru foun ida iha parte ida-ne'e.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verifika ita-nia adivinha uluk ida-idak ho sinál foun sira atu haree se ida-ne'e nafatin tuir sinál hotu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Hili adivinha razoável hotu kona-ba saida mak Ken hakarak, husi liña ida-ne'e de'it.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ita labele hatene ho loos husi liña ida de'it. Nia bele fahe notísia de'it, ka karik husu atu joga hamutuk.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Nia hakarak hatete hau katak nia iha jogu foun ida.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Fahe notísia de'it mos bele sai interpretasaun ida.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Nia hakarak fa'an jogu ida ba hau.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Liafuan ida la temi kona-ba fa'an.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Nia hanesan atu husu hau atu joga jogu ne'e hamutuk ho nia.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Karik nia hakarak halo hamutuk. Agora daudaun, sinál ne'e mak adivinha ne'ebé seidauk forte.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Haree mos sinál foun, no adivinha fali saida mak Ken hakarak.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Tau hamutuk 'jogu ba ema na'in rua' no 'nia nia maun bá kampu', interpretasaun ne'ebé natural liu mak nia buka ema ida atu joga hamutuk.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Nia hanesan konsidera hau hanesan ema daruak atu joga jogu ne'e hamutuk.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sinál rua ne'e, 'jogu ba ema na'in rua' no 'nia la iha maun', liga hotu ba adivinha ida-ne'e.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ida-ne'e la tuir sinál 'ema na'in rua'.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nia hakarak de'it hatete hau notísia.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Interpretasaun ne'e bele iha husi liña dahuluk, maibé agora aumenta ona sinál katak nia la iha ema atu joga hamutuk, nune'e interpretasaun ida-ne'e la esplika sinál hotu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Haree mos sinál ikus, no adivinha fali saida mak Ken hakarak.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Se uluk ita adivinha 'joga hamutuk', agora tenke muda husi 'ohin' ba 'loron seluk'. Sinál foun ida (isin-manas, liafuan inan nian) muda planu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Nia husu hau atu bá nia uma ohin no joga hamutuk.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ida-ne'e la tuir sinál katak nia inan dehan katak belun sira labele mai uma ohin.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Nia la hakarak joga ho hau tan.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nia fó razaun atu dehan la bele (isin-manas, liafuan inan nian), no la iha sinál ida katak nia la hakarak joga.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Nia hakarak joga hamutuk bainhira sente di'ak fali.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isin-manas mak razaun, nune'e interpretasaun ne'e mak katak sei bele bainhira isin-manas lakon ona.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.reflect: Husi ita-nia adivinha tolu, iha ne'ebé mak nia muda liu? Hatudu fraze ida ne'ebé sai razaun.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.prompt: Responde ba Ken ho fraze Inglés ida ka rua. Resposta ne'e tenke hatudu katak ita komprende saida mak Ken hakarak.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Uluk hakerek fraze ida kona-ba saúde Ken nian.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Iha fraze daruak, sujere bainhira atu joga hamutuk.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ita hatudu katak ita nota Ken nia isin-manas ka sujere atu halo iha loron seluk ka lae?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ita kontinua ko'alia kona-ba jogu Ken nian ka lae?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Iha buat ruma ne'ebé la tuir sinál uluk, hanesan dehan katak ita sei bá nia uma ohin ka lae?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Resposta ne'ebé sujere oras espesífiku ida.

x-e-e4-04.title: Email Sora nian husu saida?
x-e-e4-04.goal: Halo julgamentu kona-ba intensaun hakerek-na'in nian iha email badak ida, fó evidénsia, no responde iha Inglés tuir intensaun ne'e.
x-e-e4-04.material:
Email ida ne'ebé Sora haruka ba nia mestre (hakerek testu de'it, laiha imajen):

Dear Ms. Park,
I am sorry. I forgot my homework at home. My mom can bring it to school at 11 a.m. today. Is that OK?
Sora

Belun na'in 3 dehan saida mak Sora hakarak.
x-e-e4-04.thinking.0: Hili alegasaun ne'ebé iha evidénsia di'ak liu husi alegasaun diferente sira
x-e-e4-04.thinking.1: Halo inferénsia intensaun husi liafuan iha email
x-e-e4-04.prereq.0: Liafuan fasil hanesan homework no bring
x-e-e4-04.prereq.1: Katak 'Is that OK?' mak dalan ida atu husu lisensa
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.prompt: Interpretasaun ema ne'ebé loos liu tuir fraze iha email mak ida-ne'ebé?
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Koko interpretasaun tolu ne'e hasoru fraze iha email ida-idak, no buka liafuan ne'ebé la kona malu.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hakerek saida mak 'bring', 'today', no 'Is that OK?' ida-idak hatete.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.a: Min: "Sora wants to not hand in her homework."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.a: Buka se email dehan katak nia sei lori knaar uma nian ka lae.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.b: Jun: "Sora is asking for more time until tomorrow."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.b: Verifika liafuan ne'ebé iha email, today ka tomorrow.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.c: Hana: "Sora is asking whether she may hand in her homework this morning."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.c: Haree hamutuk buat ne'ebé '11 a.m. today' no 'Is that OK?' hatudu.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.explain: 'My mom can bring it ... at 11 a.m. today' dehan katak nia sei lori knaar uma nian iha 11 dader ohin, no 'Is that OK?' husu se ida-ne'e di'ak ka lae. La iha liafuan kona-ba la entrega knaar uma nian, no la iha mos liafuan kona-ba husu atu entrega to'o aban.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.prompt: Sai Ms. Park no responde ba Sora ho fraze Inglés ida ka rua. Responde pergunta Sora nian.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Uluk responde pergunta Sora nian ho 'Yes' ka 'No'.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Iha fraze daruak, hakerek bainhira no ba sé mak nia tenke fó knaar uma nian.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ita responde pergunta Sora nian (Is that OK?) ka lae?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ita hakerek oras ka maneira atu lori knaar uma nian ne'ebé tuir email ka lae?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Se ita-nia resposta la fó lisensa, ita hakerek razaun ka lae?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Resposta ida ne'ebé fó lisensa no aumenta mos hanoin atu lembra iha futuru.

x-e-e4-05.title: Hau bele bá Movie Day ka lae?
x-e-e4-05.goal: Haketak informasaun ne'ebé presiza atu deside husi informasaun ne'ebé la presiza, no julga husi informasaun ne'ebé ita hetan se ita bele bá ka lae.
x-e-e4-05.material:
Avisu ida iha kuadru eskola (hakerek testu de'it, laiha imajen):

Movie Day
Friday, after school
Come and watch a movie in the gym.
Bring a snack.

Situasaun Mina nian: Iha Friday nia tenke to'o uma molok 6:00 p.m., no presiza minutu 20 atu la'o husi eskola ba uma. Osan ne'ebé nia bele gasta mak 1,000 won.
x-e-e4-05.thinking.0: Kompara ho ita-nia kondisaun rasik no hili informasaun ne'ebé duni presiza
x-e-e4-05.thinking.1: Verifika se informasaun ne'ebé ita hetan kumpre kondisaun hotu ka lae
x-e-e4-05.thinking.2: Haketak informasaun ne'ebé interesante husi informasaun ne'ebé presiza
x-e-e4-05.prereq.0: Tau hamutuk oras sira (aumenta minutu 20 ba 5:30)
x-e-e4-05.prereq.1: Liafuan fasil hanesan ticket, movie, no snack
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.prompt: Hili informasaun hotu ne'ebé Mina tenke husu ba mestre atu deside se bele bá ka lae.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hakerek uluk kondisaun rua Mina nian, depois buka informasaun saida mak falta iha avisu.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ba pergunta ida-idak, hanoin se resposta bele muda desizaun 'bá' ka 'la bá'.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.a: Informasaun ne'ebé ita hakarak hatene no informasaun ne'ebé ita presiza atu deside diferente. Hanoin se bele verifika oras no osan maski laiha informasaun ida-ne'e ka lae.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.b: Ida-ne'e mak informasaun ne'ebé iha relasaun ho kondisaun oras husi kondisaun Mina nian.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.c: Ida-ne'e mak informasaun ne'ebé iha relasaun ho kondisaun osan husi kondisaun Mina nian.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.d: Avisu iha ona 'Bring a snack.' Hanoin se resposta ida-ne'e muda desizaun atu bá ka lae.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.explain: Mina iha kondisaun rua, 'to'o uma molok 6' no '1,000 won', nune'e nia bele deside atu bá de'it bainhira hatene oras ne'ebé filme remata no folin billete nian. Naran filme no hahán ki'ik mak buat sira ne'ebé bele halo nia hakarak hatene, maibé la muda desizaun.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.prompt: Mestre responde. "The movie ends at 5:30 p.m. A ticket is 1,500 won." Mina tenke halo saida?
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Verifika kondisaun rua ida-idak, ida iha tempu ida.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Verifika kondisaun oras hodi aumenta tempu la'o ba tempu remata filme nian.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.a: Osan no oras rua ne'e di'ak, nune'e nia bele bá.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.a: Verifika se ita kompara kondisaun osan ho folin billete ne'ebé fó ba ita ka lae.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.b: Bainhira filme remata, nia sei tarde ona no labele to'o uma molok 6.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.b: Aumenta minutu 20 ne'ebé nia presiza la'o ba 5:30 no kompara ho 6:00.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.c: Oras di'ak, maibé osan la natoon.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.c: Hanoin ida-ne'e verifika kondisaun rua ne'e ketak.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.explain: Filme remata iha 5:30, no ho la'o minutu 20 nia to'o iha 5:50, molok 6:00. Maibé billete folin 1,500 won, nune'e nia labele sosa ho 1,000 won. Tenke verifika kondisaun rua ne'e hotu.

x-e-e4-06.title: Hau tenke husu Ben saida?
x-e-e4-06.goal: Buka informasaun ne'ebé falta husi planu ida, no halo ita-nia rasik pergunta Inglés rua atu hetan informasaun ne'e.
x-e-e4-06.material:
Ben haruka mensajen testu ida ba Mina: "Let's do our science homework together on Saturday. Come to my house!"

Situasaun Mina nian: Ben muda ba uma foun, no Mina la hatene fatin uma foun ne'ebé. Mina iha aula natazaun iha Saturday husi 10 a.m. to'o 11 a.m.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.0: Haketak informasaun ne'ebé falta husi informasaun ne'ebé ita hatene ona
x-e-e4-06.thinking.1: Halo pergunta atu hetan informasaun ne'ebé falta
x-e-e4-06.thinking.2: Hakerek pergunta sira ne'ebé reflete ita-nia kondisaun rasik
x-e-e4-06.prereq.0: Halo pergunta saida oras, iha ne'ebé, no oinsá
x-e-e4-06.prereq.1: Lee fraze badak sira iha testu
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.prompt: Atu halo planu, hili informasaun hotu ne'ebé Mina tenke husu ba Ben.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hakerek ketak informasaun ne'ebé iha mensajen Ben nian no informasaun ne'ebé la iha.
